decisions.reason: Offshore vessel management sits close to the core offer, was raised from a mention to its own page, and fits the announced broadening of service scope, so management stays committed to it.
Crew and corporate travel management uses the firm's large seafarer pools and was presented publicly on its own page, and any weak results can be blamed on the temporary pandemic collapse in travel.
The online vessel portal represents a visible digital investment that supports the firm's announced direction toward safer and more transparent operations, so it is kept despite uncertain uptake.

The mobile performance app is the product furthest from the core and the most likely to be folded into the portal, but sunk development costs and its link to the cleaner-shipping goal favour keeping it.
